summary:
The feed subsystem is the app's main browsing surface and the tab model behind it.
1. SearchHandler (lib/src/handlers/search_handler.dart, 2443 lines) is a GetIt singleton. It owns the tabs (RxList<SearchTab>), the current index and tab id, and the paging state (pageNum/isLoading/isLastPage/errorString). It also holds tab groups, the tab-visit history (TabVisitHistory table), seen posts (SeenPost/ViewedPost, with doujin items routed to the doujin history), saved searches, merge (secondary boorus with per-booru overrides) and tab backup/restore. Restore reads the TabRestore table, in JSON (TabBackup) or the legacy '|||'/'~~~' format. It also hosts UI objects: the search TextEditingController, the grid AutoScrollController, the drawer GlobalKey, the volume-key EventChannel, plus snackbars and a rootRestate callback. SearchTab, TabBackup, TabVisit and the enums live in the same file.
2. Paging: runSearch increments pageNum before every fetch. Own lists loop up to 10 pages while nothing is visible (r85).
3. Tab backup is driven by a 30 s timer in main.dart (Home.backupTimer). Restore runs from MainApp.initHandlers through settingsHandler.postInit.
4. SearchHistoryStore is the single router between booru search history (store.db) and doujin search history (doujinData.json). HiddenByFilters supplies the words for the 'hidden by your filters' banner.
5. UI: MediaPreviews (home body) shows WaterfallView, or a WebView tab for WebView boorus. WaterfallView is one CustomScrollView inside an Obx that rebuilds on isLoading/filteredFetched. Its slivers, top to bottom:
   - MainAppBar, which carries TabsCountPill, PageIndicatorPill and NewTabButton from flow_tab_carousel.dart;
   - FlowTabCarousel;
   - MediaFilterChips (local DB feeds only);
   - KemonoCreatorHeader, FurAffinityArtistHeader and DiscoveryStrip;
   - GridBuilder (grid, or doujin list cards) or StaggeredBuilder (waterfall_flow), or a shimmer while loading.
   It also has pull-to-refresh (re-runs searchAction), volume-key scroll, scroll buttons, an optional TabPillHost, and WaterfallBottomBar (status banner + FlowSearchBar). A doujin detail tab swaps the whole view for DoujinTabView.
6. Cards: ThumbnailCardBuild → ThumbnailBuild (overlays, icons) → Thumbnail (stateful image loader with sample/thumb choice, retries, a 403 captcha probe, sprite tiles, AVIF, ThumbnailReveal, ThumbnailDecodeBox). DoujinListCard and DoujinCardMeta draw doujin list rows. The next-page trigger is the NotificationListener filtered by FeedScroll.isFeedScroll.
7. Search entry points:
   - MainSearchBar(WithActions) at the top, in the drawer and on desktop;
   - FlowSearchBar at the bottom;
   - MainSearchQueryEditorPage (4565 lines): suggestions, history, pinned, popular, metatags, tag builder, doujin/site filter cards, pin dialogs and managers, date pickers, prefix sheet;
   - TagSearchQueryEditorPage + TagSearchBox, a reusable picker built on QueryEditorController.
8. FloatingPreviewHandler keeps the floating tag-preview windows in the root overlay, each tied to its owner page route with a Back PopEntry. FloatingTagPreviewWindow is the draggable/resizable window: its own SearchTab, alias resolution, a viewer with endless paging, and a nested navigator for doujin detail windows.
9. Persistence:
   - In store.db (database backup): TabRestore, TabVisitHistory, SeenPost, ViewedPost, SearchHistory, SavedSearch, PinnedTag.
   - In settings.json: previewWindowRect, tabPill and the other UI keys.
   - tab_pill.json is not backed up.
10. Layer debt: the logic files import widgets (FlashElements, the floating window, Navigator contexts) and the widget files contain logic (DB writes for pins, booru-by-host lookup, item reload). All of it is reached through SearchHandler.instance by about 100 files.

features.name: Tab list with add/remove/move
features.navPath: Feed -> tab carousel / Tab manager (TabsCountPill) / desktop tab bar
features.what: Tabs are SearchTab objects in SearchHandler.tabs. A new tab goes before the current, after it or at the end, following the New-tab-position setting, and an insert never splits a foreign group. Removing the last tab resets it to the default tags and shows a snackbar.

features.name: Tab groups
features.navPath: Tab manager -> group actions; tag chips open into the current group
features.what: Groups are kept as contiguous blocks; inheritGroup puts a new tab in the opener's group. Groups can be renamed, dissolved or receive moved tabs, and fragmented blocks are compacted after restore.

features.name: Tab restore at startup
features.navPath: automatic (startup: 'Restoring tabs' message)
features.what: Reads TabRestore as the new JSON format or the legacy '|||'/'~~~' format. Rebuilds pool, doujin-detail, suggestion and merge tabs, and handles localized Favourites/Downloads names. A snackbar lists tabs with problems. With no backup it creates a default tab. Seen posts and visit history are loaded first.

features.name: Periodic tab backup
features.navPath: automatic (every 30 s, 10 s in debug)
features.what: generateBackupJson writes all tabs. When the only tab is the default booru with default tags, TabRestore is cleared instead. Backup is allowed only after restore, and is paused during a database restore.

features.name: Tab merge/replace from text (LoliSync, debug)
features.navPath: Settings -> Debug -> tabs session string (copy / replace); LoliSync tabs merge/replace
features.what: mergeTabs/replaceTabs accept the JSON or legacy format.

features.name: Visited tabs history
features.navPath: Tab manager -> visited tabs history dialog
features.what: Records tabs the user switched to on purpose (byUser), one entry per tab id, capped at 150, and survives restarts.

features.name: Search action
features.navPath: Search bar search button / editor submit / FlowSearchBar magnifier
features.what: Replaces the current tab in place (same id, group, overrides; keeps the doujin identity when the query is unchanged). Records search history unless the query is a suggest: query, records an Interests signal (not for local, recommendation or doujin feeds), clears the image memory cache and runs page 1.

features.name: Search reactions
features.navPath: automatic on search
features.what: A 'loli' query shows a crying-emoji snackbar (5 per session). rating:safe on gelbooru.com or danbooru shows the ratings-changed notice.

features.name: Paging / infinite scroll
features.navPath: Feed scroll near bottom (within 2 viewports), or first page not filling the screen
features.what: runSearch increments the page and fetches. Own lists read up to 10 empty pages per load. State is written only for the tab that is still current. Total count is fetched once. Loading resets after 200 ms.

features.name: Jump to page / search until page
features.navPath: Feed app bar -> 'Pg N' pill -> page number sheet
features.what: changeCurrentTabPageNumber rebuilds the tab at a start page. searchCurrentTabUntilPageNumber loads page after page with a delay until the target or an error, and can be cancelled.

features.name: Merge (multibooru) tabs
features.navPath: Multibooru toggle / secondary booru selector
features.what: mergeAction sets the secondary boorus and keeps the per-booru tag overrides and inherit flags of boorus still in the set.

features.name: Booru edit re-points open tabs
features.navPath: Settings -> Boorus -> edit booru -> save
features.what: applyBooruEdit rebuilds the handler only when the type or URL changed; otherwise it adopts the new Booru object.

features.name: Saved searches
features.navPath: Search bar save button (label dialog); FlowSearchBar save button; saved searches list -> open / open in another booru
features.what: Snapshots tags, booru, secondaries and overrides. Doujin tabs go to the doujin store. Opening a saved search follows the New-tab-position setting.

features.name: Seen posts dimming + viewing history
features.navPath: Settings -> Viewer -> dim seen posts (+ clear seen); automatic when viewing
features.what: markPostSeen adds the post key to SeenPost and the item to ViewedPost, or to the doujin history for doujin items. Cards dim with an eye icon.

features.name: Favourite toggle (double-tap / bulk)
features.navPath: Feed card double-tap; multi-select favourite
features.what: Doujin items go to toggleFavouriteSynced. Booru items: loadItem when tags are missing, vibrate, DB update, snatch-on-favourite, mirror to the site's favourites (kemono), and stay visible until reload (exemptFromLiveFilter).

features.name: Doujin detail tabs
features.navPath: Doujin card -> open as tab; restored tabs
features.what: SearchTab.doujinPostURL/Title/Thumb. seedPersistedDoujinItem plants a stub so keyed galleries reload after a restart. id:<n>/<key> query helpers.

features.name: Pool tabs and suggestion tabs
features.navPath: Pool entries / Suggested strip -> open in new tab
features.what: A poolId builds PoolPostsHandler; a suggest: query builds SuggestionHandler; both are rebuilt on restore.

features.name: Search history routing
features.navPath: automatic; editor History card; History page
features.what: SearchHistoryStore records and reads booru history in SQLite and doujin history in doujinData.json, routed by the target booru. Legacy doujin rows are filtered out of booru reads.

features.name: Hidden-by-filters banner
features.navPath: Feed bottom banner when everything loaded is hidden
features.what: 'Everything loaded (N) is hidden by your filters' plus a per-reason summary. At the end of the list the tap opens Settings -> Filters; otherwise it loads the next page.

features.name: Feed status banner
features.navPath: Feed bottom (above the search bar)
features.what: Shows 'Loading page N' with elapsed seconds (tap to retry if stuck for more than 5 s), errors with an HTML message (tap retries), no results with the source's emptyNote, or end reached. It can be collapsed, has blur unless low-performance mode is on, and leaves a gesture-inset spacer when idle.

features.name: Bottom floating search bar
features.navPath: Settings -> User interface -> bottom search bar
features.what: A blurred pill: the magnifier runs the search; removable type-coloured chips (✕ removes the tag and searches); tap opens the editor; history button; save search; accent arrow. Hides on scroll down.

features.name: Top/drawer/desktop search bar
features.navPath: Main drawer search bar; desktop home top bar
features.what: MainSearchBarWithActions: chips (tap opens the editor, long-press edits that tag, ✕ deletes the tag without searching), clear (when the text equals the tab query), reset (when edited), save search with a label dialog, search (long-press opens a new tab), Hero to the editor, chips re-rendered every 3 s.

features.name: Search chip rendering
features.navPath: Search bars, editors, TagSearchBox
features.what: MainSearchTagChip: colour by tag type; metatags pink with sort/user/date icons and ≤/≥ marks; dates prettified; exclude (—) and OR (~) markers; merge booru number with favicon or a red '?#' when invalid; delete button.

features.name: Main query editor
features.navPath: Tap the search bar / tab card / FlowSearchBar
features.what: Typed suggestions: source catalog for key: input, metatag autocomplete, site suggestions, or DB plus history. Tap edits a chip, long-press opens tag actions. Search pops and runs; long-press opens a new tab. Pull to refresh suggestions. Layout can be reversed for a top input. Incognito keyboard. 'Prefix' toolbar item for exclude/OR/booru number.

features.name: Keyboard quick-actions bar
features.navPath: Settings -> User interface -> searchbar quick actions (Android/iOS)
features.what: Buttons above the keyboard: insert '_', paste, hide keyboard, submit/add (long-press: new tab or tag actions).

features.name: Suggestion/tag action sheet
features.navPath: Editor -> long-press suggestion or chip
features.what: Type colour and name, Add, Exclude, an inline TagContentPreview strip, Copy, Pin/Unpin (doujin pins go to the doujin store).

features.name: History card in editor
features.navPath: Editor (empty input) -> History card; Settings -> Modular UI -> Search window -> History
features.what: Chips for recent searches with a favourite heart. Tap opens a sheet with Apply, Open, Open in new tab, Copy. The chevron opens the full History page.

features.name: Pinned tags card + manager
features.navPath: Editor -> Pinned tags card; Settings -> Modular UI -> Search window -> Pinned tags
features.what: Label filter, sort cycle (custom / A-Z / Z-A), hidden pins excluded, follow pins excluded. The manager dialog has search, sort, reorder (DB only), add manually (TagSearchBox with booru selector), edit labels, unpin, and tap to insert.

features.name: Popular tags card
features.navPath: Editor -> Popular card; Settings -> Modular UI -> Search window -> Popular tags
features.what: getTagSuggestions('') chips with counts and a retry button. Hidden on Favourites/Downloads.

features.name: Metatags card + sheet
features.navPath: Editor -> Metatags card (first 15 + More / chevron)
features.what: Inserts key:, a single or range date picker, or a compare mode (=, ≤, ≥). Free-metatags notice. Cheat-sheet link.

features.name: Tag builder card
features.navPath: Editor -> Tag builder card
features.what: One chip per catalog namespace with the stored count. The picker sheet filters the local list; tap inserts, long-press inserts negated. Pull, Pull more/retry, Clear and pull again, Stop with progress. With the database off the card shows a note.

features.name: Doujin/site filters card
features.navPath: Editor -> Filters card; Settings -> Modular UI -> Search window -> Site filters (booru sources)
features.what: FilterChips that rewrite query terms; source defaults (SourceSettings.defaultFilters) show as checked.

features.name: Generic tag picker (TagSearchBox)
features.navPath: Add new tab dialog; Snatcher page; Tags filters add; Booru page/edit; Pinned tags manual add
features.what: An input that opens TagSearchQueryEditorPage in single or multiple mode, with an optional booru selector and returns the result.

features.name: Tab cards carousel
features.navPath: Feed header under the app bar
features.what: The active card (wide: favicon, name, count, query, edit, loading state; tap opens the editor), peek cards (tap switches, recorded as byUser), add card, dots, covers. Shows only the current section (doujin or others). Fixed extents.

features.name: App bar pills
features.navPath: Feed app bar
features.what: 'N tabs' opens the Tab manager. 'Pg N' opens the page sheet. New tab: tap follows the setting, hold opens the Add-new-tab sheet.

features.name: Tab pill
features.navPath: Settings -> User interface -> Tab pill (experimental)
features.what: Floating 'n/total' with the cover. Tap opens the large carousel sheet; a horizontal fling moves to the previous/next tab in the section; hold without moving opens the tab manager; hold and drag moves the pill (position saved as fractions).

features.name: Grid/staggered/list layouts
features.navPath: Settings -> User interface -> preview display / fallback / columns; Source settings -> GRID (feed cards, list height, cover width, cover display, columns, tag strip)
features.what: Square or 9:16 grid. Staggered when size data exists, with a fallback otherwise. Doujin adapt forces staggered. Doujin list cards. Per-source column overrides.

features.name: Card gestures
features.navPath: Feed card
features.what: Tap opens the viewer (mobile; zoom transition, route named 'viewer') or a doujin's DetailPage. Double-tap favourites. Long-press multi-selects (doujin: item menu). Secondary tap copies the file URL. Desktop: tap sets the viewer item and the first item is selected after a search.

features.name: Multi-select overlay
features.navPath: Feed card long-press, then checkboxes
features.what: Bottom-left checkbox or selection number. Selection is per tab.

features.name: Card badges and icons
features.navPath: Feed card overlays
features.what: Favourite/marked star, snatched or queued (pulsing), AI, comments, notes, sound, media icon (handler.mediaIconFor), burst count badge, doujin language badge, merge booru index + favicon, favourites/downloads source favicon + name (tap opens a webview), debug copy-item button, snatch progress ring.

features.name: Doujin card footer + all-tags sheet
features.navPath: Doujin feed card footer '+N'
features.what: Up to 5 tags, starred ones in gold first. The sheet groups tags by namespace; tapping a tag opens a background tab.

features.name: Doujin list cards
features.navPath: Source settings -> GRID -> Feed cards: List
features.what: Cover column (fit/crop/adapt), title that scrolls sideways, uploader, 3 rows of tags that scroll sideways, kind/language/pages.

features.name: Thumbnail loading
features.navPath: automatic
features.what: Thumbnail or sample quality, with a low-quality placeholder under samples. 200 ms delay plus fade, skipped for seen URLs. Resize decode via ThumbnailDecodeBox. Blur and hidden-item eye (pixelate on low-performance). Up to 8 retries (4 on low-performance or debug). 403 probe through the captcha interceptor; refreshes when the media epoch bumps. Sprite tiles fall back to the cover. AVIF. Schale spare fallbacks. Records doujin cover aspects. Hero transitions. 'Tap to update or retry' reloads the item for favourites/downloads.

features.name: Page tile loader
features.navPath: Doujin detail pages grid / reader filmstrip
features.what: Asks the source for each page's own thumbnail (e-hentai sprite blocks) and cancels when the tile leaves the screen.

features.name: Pull to refresh
features.navPath: Feed pull down
features.what: Re-runs searchAction with the current tags.

features.name: Scroll buttons
features.navPath: Settings -> User interface -> scroll grid buttons position (left/right/disabled)
features.what: Page up/down with long-press repeat; hides or shows the bars. Hidden on desktop and while loading with no items.

features.name: Volume-key scrolling
features.navPath: Settings -> Viewer -> volume buttons scroll + speed
features.what: Native volume key events scroll the feed while it is the active page.

features.name: Feed scrollbar
features.navPath: Settings -> Modular UI -> Preview grid -> Feed scrollbar
features.what: Draggable scrollbar on the side chosen by hand side.

features.name: Loading shimmer
features.navPath: automatic (feed first page, thumbnails)
features.what: Shimmer grid while loading (a spinner on low-performance) and a shimmer card per loading thumbnail.

features.name: Viewer return behaviour
features.navPath: automatic after closing the viewer
features.what: Scrolls the grid to the viewed item, clears the viewed item for 5 s, resets notes, resets quality toggles and refilters after 500 ms, shows the header/bottom bar, and keeps position across an orientation change.

features.name: Media filter chips
features.navPath: Favourites / Downloads / Collections / History feeds
features.what: All / Images / Video / Sound filter for the handler's fetched list.

features.name: Discovery strip
features.navPath: Feed header on xxxfollow/redgifs-style sources
features.what: CREATORS avatars and SIMILAR TAGS pills; a tap runs that search in the current tab.

features.name: Kemono creator card
features.navPath: Kemono/Pawchive creator tab header
features.what: Banner, avatar, name, service, post count, favourites, updated date. Favourite (signed in), Announcements page, DMs (sites that have them), Tags picker (adds a term and searches).

features.name: FurAffinity artist card
features.navPath: FurAffinity user:/gallery:/scraps:/favorites:/folder tab header
features.what: Avatar and counts. Watch/Unwatch when logged in. Gallery / Scraps / Favorites chips. Folders list. Strips toggle shows 3 preview rows for the session.

features.name: Doujin detail tab view
features.navPath: A doujin detail tab
features.what: The tab is the detail page itself. Error screen: close tab, open in browser, tabs drawer, Retry (same tab search), copy link. Edge handle for the mini tab manager. First fetch on mount.

features.name: No-booru / restoring placeholders
features.navPath: Home with no boorus / during restore
features.what: Buttons: add booru, help wiki, settings. 'Restoring previous session' spinner. WebView boorus get an embedded browser tab.

features.name: Floating tag preview windows
features.navPath: Viewer tag chip preview icon / tag menu Preview / strip header button; doujin item menu -> preview
features.what: Window owned by its page route (hidden while another page is on top, dropped when its page pops; Back closes the window first). Drag the title bar, resize the corner (rect persisted), minimize to a pill (drag, tap restores, long-press closes), close, extra-tags box, booru picker (same domain only, filter when there are more than 6), videos/GIFs filter cycle, open in new tab, open in group (window ducks), tag hub, alias auto-match banner, count, infinite grid, viewer with endless paging, double-tap favourite, retry. Doujin windows host the detail page in a nested navigator. Opening feeds the booru Interests profile (not doujin).

fileHomes.role: Floating preview window registry, route ownership, Back pop entries, overlay host
Tabs model, paging, groups, saved searches, seen posts, backup/restore
Doujin detail tab content + error screen
Tab cards carousel + app bar pills
FA artist card above the feed
Kemono creator card above the feed
Main query editor page and all its cards/dialogs
Home body: placeholders / WebView tab / WaterfallView
Suggestion search controller + keyboard actions bar
Waterfall-flow sliver with aspect sizing / adapt
Generic tag picker page + input box
Tag builder chip + catalog picker sheet
The feed CustomScrollView and card actions
Asks source for page tile thumbnails
Grid card: gestures, highlight, doujin footer, badges, seen dim

layerViolations.reason: Logic builds snackbars with Text/Column/Colors (removed last tab, tabs restored/merged/replaced, search reactions, ratings notice, site favourite refused) and the enums carry locName/color(BuildContext)
layerViolations.fix: Emit SearchNotice events (stream/ValueNotifier) that a feed-ui listener turns into snackbars; move HasTabWithTagResult.locName/color and TabAddMode.locName to UI extensions

layerViolations.imports: AutoScrollController, TextEditingController, FocusNode, GlobalKey (mainDrawerKey), EventChannel volume
layerViolations.reason: UI controllers and a platform channel live in the logic singleton
layerViolations.fix: Move gridScrollController/searchTextController/mainDrawerKey into a FeedUiController in features/feed/ui; volume EventChannel into core/platform/volume_keys.dart
Move TabBackup (and TabVisit) to lib/models/tab_backup.dart; saved_search imports the model

layerViolations.reason: Logic inserts an OverlayEntry building FloatingPreviewOverlayStack (UI)
layerViolations.fix: Mount the overlay from the UI: an app-level FloatingPreviewOverlayHost that listens to the controller, or register an overlay builder at startup

layerViolations.reason: Logic depends on a feed widget State type
layerViolations.fix: Replace the keys with a BarsVisibility ValueNotifier (show/hide) that the header and bottom bar listen to

layerViolations.reason: Download logic builds ThumbnailBuild inside snackbars
layerViolations.fix: Emit download notices; the UI renders the thumbnail

layerViolations.reason: A pure data mapping lives in a 4.5k-line UI file
layerViolations.fix: Move doujinPinsAsPinnedTags and the pin/unpin/label DB writes to features/tags/logic/pinned_tag_actions.dart

layerViolations.reason: Persistence calls directly in dialogs (showPinTagDialog, showUnpinTagDialog, manager, reorder)
layerViolations.fix: PinnedTagsStore/actions in feature logic; dialogs return results only

layerViolations.reason: Item reload + DB write logic in a widget file, also used by image_viewer and video_viewer
layerViolations.fix: Move to features/viewer/logic/item_refresher.dart with the booru-by-host resolver in sources/framework

layerViolations.imports: SettingsHandler.booruList scan + Sankaku/Idol handler known URLs
layerViolations.reason: Source resolution logic duplicated in UI

layerViolations.imports: flutter material (RichTextController styles, Icon in TagSuggestion), widgets file location
layerViolations.reason: QueryEditorController (logic) sits in widgets and creates TagSuggestion with Icon widgets; TagSuggestion (model) holds an Icon
layerViolations.fix: Logic in features/feed/logic; TagSuggestion gets a source enum (database/history) and the UI maps it to icons

layerViolations.reason: Persistence from UI with sync IO
Feed UI imports the app/root layer (MainAppBar) and viewer/doujin pages directly
layerViolations.fix: Move MainAppBar into features/feed/ui; open viewer/detail through a navigation facade (features/viewer/ui/open_viewer.dart)

layerViolations.reason: Generic shimmer file reads feed settings (ThumbnailsShimmerList)
layerViolations.fix: Keep Shimmer/ShimmerLoading/ShimmerCard in core/ui; move ThumbnailsShimmerList to feed/ui

layerViolations.reason: Feed header depends on drawer and viewer widgets (FurAffinityFolderList, TagContentPreview)
layerViolations.fix: Move FurAffinityFolderList and TagContentPreview into shared feature-ui modules (tags/ui/tag_content_preview.dart)

features/tabs/logic/tab_persistence.dart: restoreTabs*, merge/replace (legacy + new), generateBackupJson, parseTabFromBackup, handleFavDlsNameChange, backupTabs.
features/tabs/logic/tab_visit_history.dart.

features/history/logic/seen_posts.dart: seenPostKeys, markPostSeen, clearSeenPosts.
features/feed/logic/saved_searches.dart.
features/feed/ui/search_notices.dart: the snackbars.
features/feed/ui/feed_ui_controller.dart: searchTextController, gridScrollController, mainDrawerKey, rootRestate.
splits.risk: About 100 files and many tests call SearchHandler.instance.<member>, so the facade must keep every public member (delegate or re-export) and the GetIt register/unregister. Obx widgets subscribe to tabs/index/tabId/pageNum/isLoading Rx fields, which must stay the same instances. changeTabIndex writes searchTextController and paging Rx state together. TabBackup JSON must stay byte-compatible: SavedSearch and doujin_migration reuse the schema.

feed/ui/query_editor/main_search_query_editor_page.dart: the page, using QueryEditorController instead of its copy of runSearch.
feed/ui/query_editor/tag_suggestion_text.dart.
feed/ui/query_editor/metatags.dart: AddMetatagBottomSheet, Result, MetatagsBlock, single/range date pickers.
feed/ui/query_editor/suggestions_main_content.dart: SuggestionsMainContent, SearchSectionCard, EditorSourceMixin made public.
feed/ui/query_editor/history_block.dart.

Tests import this path and use keys 'doujin-filter-<key>-<value|(default)>', TagBuilderBlock, DoujinFiltersBlock (doujin_filters_test, filter_chip_keys_test, tag_builder_block_test, furaffinity_test, shimmie_r34us_filters_test). tag_view, kemono_sidebar, booru_source_settings_view, tab_per_booru_tag_overrides and pinned_tags_page import symbols from it.

bugs.title: mergeTabsNew keeps only duplicates (condition inverted)
bugs.scenario: LoliSync tabs in merge mode (or any mergeTabs call with JSON) carrying tabs the device does not have: none of them are added. Tabs identical to existing ones (no secondaries) are added again as duplicates. Tabs with secondary boorus are never added, because List == List compares identity.
bugs.evidence: if (newTab.selectedBooru.value.name != null && tabs.any((tab) => same name && tab.secondaryBoorus...toList() == newTab...toList() && tab.tags == newTab.tags)) { restoredTabs.add(newTab); } The comment says 'add only if there are not already the same tab'; the legacy version uses indexWhere(...) == -1.

bugs.title: removeTagFromSearch removes substrings from other tags
bugs.scenario: FlowSearchBar chip ✕ on 'blue' with the query 'blue blue_eyes' leaves ' _eyes'; removing 'cat' from 'cat category' leaves ' egory'. The broken query is then searched at once.
bugs.evidence: searchTextController.text = text.replaceAll(regex...).replaceAll('-$tag','').replaceAll('~$tag','').replaceAll(tag, ''); this is a plain substring replace with no token boundaries. Called from flow_search_bar.dart:94 _removeTag, followed by searchAction.

bugs.title: Tab changes from the last 30 s are lost when the app is killed
bugs.scenario: Open or close tabs, then swipe the app away or let Android reap it within 30 s: on the next start the old tab set comes back.
bugs.evidence: backupTabs runs only from Timer.periodic(30 s) in _HomeState.initState. didChangeAppLifecycleState (paused/hidden/detached) flushes the recommender and doujin data but never calls searchHandler.backupTabs().

bugs.title: ShimmerWrap ignores `enabled`, so the shimmer ticker runs forever in low-performance mode
bugs.scenario: Low performance mode (shitDevice) on: the feed passes enabled:false. Shimmer still starts repeat() in initState, and no ShimmerLoading child ever mounts (the spinner and the shimmer-less thumbnails are used instead), so stop() is never reached. The AnimationController ticks every frame for as long as the feed lives, on the devices meant to save work. Behind the non-opaque viewer (isActive false) the shimmer keeps animating too.
bugs.evidence: ShimmerWrap.build returns Shimmer(enabled: true, ...) whatever this.enabled is. ShimmerState.initState: if (widget.enabled) _shimmerController.repeat(...). stop() is called only from deactivateChild/didUpdateWidget.

bugs.title: Editor dispose leaves the debounce and request alive, so setState runs after dispose
bugs.scenario: Type a letter and press back within 400 ms (or while DB/catalog/metatag suggestions load): the Timer fires and calls setState() at line 216. The metatag/DB/error branches (lines 243, 265, 319) call setState after awaits with no mounted check. Release builds hit a null _element (an uncaught error in the log); debug builds assert.
bugs.evidence: dispose() removes listeners and disposes the controller/focus node but never calls debounce?.cancel() or cancelToken?.cancel(). The runSearch Timer callback starts with loading=true; setState(() {}). Only the data branch checks mounted.

bugs.title: Thumbnail attaches image-stream listeners after it was disposed
bugs.scenario: Fast scroll: the 200 ms timer has fired and startDownloading is awaiting Tools.getFileCustomHeaders when the cell is disposed. It then resolves the provider and adds listeners that disposables() already passed over. The download and the decode go on and the listener keeps the State and ImageStream alive.
bugs.evidence: startDownloading: mainProvider.value = await getImageProvider(...); then mainImageStream = ...resolve(); addListener. There is no mounted check after either await (line 381 for extra too). dispose() calls disposables() before that.

bugs.title: tryToLoadAndUpdateItem cannot be cancelled by its caller
bugs.scenario: Tap 'retry' on a favourite thumbnail, then scroll away: loadItem keeps running (requests, captcha check), because the State's loadItemCancelToken stays null.
bugs.evidence: tryToLoadAndUpdateItem(item, CancelToken? cancelToken) { ... cancelToken?.cancel(); cancelToken = CancelToken(); ... } reassigns the parameter only. _ThumbnailState passes loadItemCancelToken (always null), and disposables() cancels nothing.

bugs.title: RangeError in card builders right after the last file of a snatch batch
bugs.scenario: After the last item of a batch: queueProgress becomes booruItems.length (snatch_handler.dart:321) while current stays non-null until the stream's onDone. A frame in between evaluates current.booruItems[queueProgress] and throws in every visible card's ListenableBuilder, and in _ThumbnailBottomRightIcons' Obx (thumbnail_build.dart:419).
bugs.evidence: final bool isCurrentlyBeingSnatched = current?.booruItems[queueProgress] == item && total != 0; the index is read before the total check, with no bounds check.

bugs.title: History entry for a deleted booru opens a tab on an unknown booru
bugs.scenario: Editor History card -> entry whose booru was removed -> Open or Open in new tab: searchAction/addTabByString gets Booru.unknown (type null). The intended 'unknown booru type' snackbar never shows.
bugs.evidence: final booru = booruList.firstWhere(..., orElse: Booru.unknown) is never null. showHistoryEntryActions checks `if (booru != null)` before searchAction / addTabByString.

bugs.title: Jump to page and merge toggle drop the tab's group, pool and doujin state
bugs.scenario: A tab in group 'A' -> Pg pill -> jump to page 5: the tab leaves its group, loses its per-booru overrides, and a pool tab turns into a plain text search. Toggling merge boorus (mergeAction, line 1109) also drops the group, pool and doujin fields.
bugs.evidence: changeCurrentTabPageNumber: SearchTab(currentBooru, currentSecondaryBoorus.value, currentTab.tags, tabId: currentTab.id) with no groupName/tagOverrides/inheritMainTags/poolId/doujin*. searchAction, in contrast, copies groupName and overrides.

bugs.title: replaceTabs can leave zero tabs
bugs.scenario: Debug page 'replace tabs' or LoliSync replace with tabs whose boorus are not on this device: restoredTabs is empty, tabs.value = [], and changeTabIndex returns early. Every currentTab read (WaterfallView, MainSearchBar, WaterfallErrorButtons, MediaPreviews -> WaterfallView) throws a RangeError. replaceTabsLegacy also reads booruAndTags[2] without a length check (line 1455).
bugs.evidence: replaceTabsNew: tabs.value = restoredTabs; changeTabIndex(newSelectedIndex) with no empty fallback. MediaPreviews returns WaterfallView even when tabs.isEmpty (media_previews.dart:134), and its initState reads currentTab.scrollPosition.

bugs.title: removeTabs mutates tabs.value without refreshing the RxList
bugs.scenario: Tab manager -> delete several tabs that sit after the current one: the index does not change, so TabsCountPill ('N tabs'), FlowTabCarousel and TabPill (Obx on tabs) still show the deleted tabs until something else triggers a rebuild.
bugs.evidence: for (tab in tabsToRemove) tabs.value.remove(tab); and tabs.value[0] = newTab mutate the inner list (no refresh()). changeTabIndex only sets index/tabId when they differ.

bugs.title: Catalog picker filter can show the previous query's rows
bugs.scenario: Type in the picker filter while a page read is in flight: _reset clears the rows and calls _loadMore, which returns because _loading is true. The old read then appends the OLD query's rows and the new query is never loaded.
bugs.evidence: _reset(){_offset=0;_rows.clear();await count; await _loadMore();} and _loadMore(){ if (_loading || _lastPage) return; ...}. The in-flight call does _rows.addAll(got); _offset += got.length.

bugs.title: Older suggestion results can overwrite newer ones
bugs.scenario: Type 'artist:a' then 'artist:ab' quickly: the catalog, metatag-autocomplete and DB/history paths have no cancel token. Whichever await finishes last wins, so the list can show suggestions for the older text. The same applies to the main editor's copy (main_search_query_editor_page.dart:224-320).
bugs.evidence: Only the getTagSuggestions branch uses cancelToken. suggestFromCatalog/getAutoComplete/dbHandler.getTags results are assigned to suggestedTags without checking that the input still matches.

bugs.title: Kemono banner/avatar and discovery avatars bypass the app UA and media headers
bugs.scenario: Creator banner/icon on kemono/pawchive behind DDoS-Guard/Cloudflare, or xxxfollow/redgifs avatars: they are fetched by Image.network/NetworkImage with Dart's default UA, no cookies and no Referer, so they 403 and show the placeholder while the rest of the site works.
bugs.evidence: Image.network(KemonoSite.of(booru).bannerUrl(...)) and NetworkImage(iconUrl) here; NetworkImage(avatar) in discovery_strip.dart:61. The project invariant: every request uses Tools.browserUserAgent through CustomNetworkImage.

bugs.title: Pull-to-refresh counts as a new search
bugs.scenario: Pull to refresh a tag feed 5 times: 5 InterestsHandler.onSearch signals (inflating For You) and 5 search-history bumps.
bugs.evidence: onRefresh: () => searchHandler.searchAction(currentTab.tags, null). searchAction calls InterestsHandler.onSearch and SearchHistoryStore.record for any non-empty plain query.

bugs.title: Floating window 'Open in a new tab' ignores the 'previous' tab position
bugs.scenario: New tab position set to 'prev': the window's new-tab button puts the tab at the end.
bugs.evidence: final addMode = settingsHandler.defaultTabAddMode == 'next' ? TabAddMode.next : TabAddMode.end; addTabByString(addMode: null) would follow the setting.

bugs.title: Doujin floating preview searches id:<serverId> without the gallery key
bugs.scenario: Doujin item menu -> floating preview on HDoujin/niyaniya/e-hentai: the window's SearchTab gets tag 'id:N' with no doujinPostURL, so seedPersistedDoujinItem cannot run and keyed sources may not resolve the gallery (the case SearchTab.doujinIdQuery exists for).
bugs.evidence: openDoujinPreview: FloatingPreviewEntry(tag: 'id:${item.serverId}', doujinItem: item). The window's loadPreview builds SearchTab(selectedBooru, null, _effectiveTag) and never passes doujinPostURL or doujinIdQuery(item).

bugs.title: Unfilled-screen auto-load can start a second concurrent page fetch
bugs.scenario: The first page does not fill the screen: every Obx rebuild schedules a postFrame callback that waits 500 ms and calls runSearch without re-checking isLoading. The NotificationListener path or another rebuild may have started a fetch meanwhile, so two pages load at once.
bugs.evidence: if (hasClients && !isLoading) { ... await Future.delayed(500 ms); unawaited(searchHandler.runSearch()); } and runSearch itself has no in-flight guard.

bugs.title: searchAction's empty-tabs branch throws before it can create a tab
bugs.scenario: searchAction called while tabs is empty: currentSecondaryBoorus reads currentTab -> tabs[0] -> RangeError.
bugs.evidence: if (tabs.isEmpty) { ... SearchTab(settingsHandler.booruList[0], currentSecondaryBoorus.value, text) }; currentSecondaryBoorus => currentTab.secondaryBoorus.

bugs.title: Tab pill position is not in backup/restore
bugs.scenario: Back up and restore to a new phone: the dragged pill position is lost (user rule: every persisted setting is backed up).
bugs.evidence: TabPillHost writes '${SettingsHandler.instance.path}tab_pill.json'. BackupItems.fileOf (services/backup_plan.dart) lists settings.json, boorus.json, doujinData.json, sourceSettings.json, bookmarks.json, boards.json, tags.json, store.db and vectors.db only.

bugs.title: Creator header can show the previous creator's index data
bugs.scenario: Switch quickly between two kemono creator tabs: _load for creator A finishes after B's and sets _indexed to A (name, favourites, updated date).
bugs.evidence: _load(): _indexed = await store.get(widget.creator...); there is no check that widget.creator is still the requested one. didUpdateWidget starts another _load.

bugs.title: Restored selected tab can shift when an entry fails
bugs.scenario: A TabBackup entry throws in parseTabFromBackup (caught and skipped): newSelectedIndex is an index into tabBackups, not restoredTabs, so the wrong tab becomes current.
bugs.evidence: newSelectedIndex = tabBackups.indexWhere((tb) => tb == tabBackup); the catch skips adding to restoredTabs.

fragile.rule: pageNum is incremented BEFORE each fetch; the first page number comes from BooruHandlerFactory.startingPage (default -1). retrySearch decrements and re-runs. Own lists loop at most ownListPagesPerLoad=10, and state is written only while the same tab is current.

Keys t,b,i,g,p,pn,dp,dt,dth,sb,to,in,s must stay. A string starting with '[' is JSON, otherwise legacy 'booru|||tags|||selected~~~...'. Only false inherit flags and non-empty overrides are stored. fromJson falls back to {t,b}. SavedSearch and the doujin migration reuse this schema.
An in-place search change keeps tabId (visited history is one entry per tab id). Restore uses TabBackup.id.

No tab backup before restoreTabs finishes, and none during a database restore; otherwise the empty or default tab set overwrites TabRestore. generateBackupJson returns null (clear) for the only-default-tab case.

fragile.where: SearchHistoryStore (the only router), markPostSeen, toggleItemFavourite/updateFavForMultipleItems, addCurrentTabAsSavedSearch, FloatingPreviewHandler.open (no Interests for doujin), floating booru picker sameDomain, FlowSearchBar/MainSearchTagChip colours, pin dialogs (doujin pins id -1), ThumbnailCardBuild footer stars from DoujinDataHandler
fragile.rule: A doujin query, view, favourite, pin or saved search never reaches the booru tables and vice versa. Guarded by doujin_separation_test, doujin_favourite_tags_test and doujin_drawer_refresh_test.
'suggest: … post:' queries never go to search history or InterestsHandler.onSearch, and they rebuild SuggestionHandler on restore (suggestion_query_test).

Any list that jumps to an index must have fixed or builder-given extents (r39: 4,529 tabs built thousands of cards). FlowTabCarousel.cardsBuilt is asserted in tab_cards_test; card keys are flow-card-<tab index>; sectionIndexes splits by hasReader.
Only depth-0 vertical notifications trigger next-page loading and sendToScrollStream; horizontal scrolls inside cards must not (r66, feed_scroll_test).

fragile.what: No cache clear on tab switch
fragile.rule: Use Tools.trimMemoryCacheIfFull, never forceClearMemoryCache, on a switch (r39).

A window belongs to its owner page route and is dropped (with a log line) when the owner closed. _PreviewBackEntry blocks Back and closes the newest window in a microtask; page Back handlers stand down via hasWindowFor(topPageRoute). Never call ModalRoute.of(context) in callbacks. routeObserver must be in navigatorObservers. floating_preview_owner_test covers this.
The viewer route must stay named 'viewer' for close logging and trace counts.
Check ModularUi.isOn where the widget is built; never build and then hide.

fragile.where: thumbnail.dart (CustomNetworkImage with Tools.getFileCustomHeaders, thumbnailFallbacksFor http(s) only)
fragile.rule: Every image fetch goes through CustomNetworkImage/SpriteTileImage with the source's media headers. CustomNetworkImage == compares the headers map by identity. Only Schale's spare server is used as a fallback (r89).

Doujin covers decode for their box × 1.5 and are never upscaled; everything else follows the square/rectangle/staggered rules verbatim. Doujin covers use FilterQuality.high (thumbnail_decode_box_test).
List cards force non-staggered; doujin 'adapt' forces staggered whatever hasSizeData says.

fragile.where: tab_pill.dart, doujin_list_card.dart, main editor DoujinFiltersBlock, tag_type_strip, furaffinity_artist_header, doujin_tab_view, main_search_bar, floating window
fragile.rule: Keep 'tab-pill', 'doujin-list-card-row|surface|cover|title|tags', 'doujin-filter-<key>-<value|(default)>', 'tag-type-<ns>', 'fa-artist-*', 'fa-strip-*', 'doujin-tab-close|open-browser|tabs|reason', 'clear-button', 'reset-button', 'save-search-button', 'search-button', 'floating-preview-<id>'.

fragile.what: Doujin detail tab key and open counting
fragile.rule: Switching back to a doujin tab must not count as a new open (r39).

fragile.what: Favourite does not hide the post live
fragile.rule: Favouriting keeps the post visible for the session; filters apply on load.

fragile.where: _snapInsertionIndex, addTabByString end-of-group, moveTabsToGroup, compactGroupBlocks after restore
fragile.rule: A group is always one contiguous block.
Keep the names: traces and perf_trace tests read them.
Restore must map the Favourites/Downloads booru names across every AppLocale.

perf.issue: Every restored tab eagerly builds its BooruHandler (factory) and its Rx fields at startup
perf.impact: Startup scales with the tab count (the user has had 4,500+ tabs); thousands of handlers are built before the first frame of the feed
perf.safeFix: Create the handler lazily on first access (late, built on demand) while keeping the SearchTab fields; pool/suggest/doujin branches the same way

perf.issue: restoreTabs awaits loadSeenPosts (entire SeenPost table into a Set) and loadVisitedTabsHistory before restoring tabs
perf.impact: Adds DB time on the startup critical path, growing with history
perf.safeFix: Run them in parallel with the tab restore, or after the first paint (dimming fills in when ready)

perf.issue: backupTabs jsonEncodes every tab on the UI isolate and writes the DB every 30 s even when nothing changed
perf.impact: Periodic jank with many tabs, constant DB writes
perf.safeFix: Dirty flag set by tab mutations; encode in compute; also back up on pause

perf.issue: One Obx rebuilds the whole CustomScrollView (app bar, carousel, headers, grid sliver) on every isLoading change and every filteredFetched change, and schedules postFrame callbacks each time
perf.impact: Extra builds/layouts per page load; headers rebuilt needlessly
perf.safeFix: Narrow the Obx to the grid sliver and the loading flag; keep the headers const or outside

perf.issue: The loading overlay builds a new BooruHandler through BooruHandlerFactory on each rebuild, and the LayoutBuilder schedules a postFrame callback on every layout of every thumbnail
perf.impact: Allocation and callbacks per visible thumbnail during scrolls
perf.safeFix: Use BooruHandlerFactory's cached helper or compute hasLoadItemSupport once in initState; register the postFrame only when constraints changed

perf.issue: Favourites/Downloads/Collections/ForYou cards scan the whole booru list with Uri.tryParse twice per build (Thumbnail booru + favicon)
perf.impact: O(boorus) parsing per card build in local feeds
perf.safeFix: Cache host -> Booru in a resolver (sources/framework) invalidated on booruList change

perf.issue: Every visible card listens to snatchHandler.received (changes on every downloaded chunk)
perf.impact: All visible cards rebuild their overlay builder per chunk while anything downloads
perf.safeFix: Listen to current/queueProgress only and wrap the progress ring in a builder that is created only for the card being snatched

perf.issue: Timer.periodic 3 s setState for as long as the bar is mounted (drawer, desktop, editor)
perf.impact: Rebuilds all chips every 3 s forever
perf.safeFix: Rebuild on TagHandler type updates (a notifier) instead of polling

perf.issue: Each suggestion row runs a FutureBuilder DB query (getPinnedTag) on every rebuild, up to 100 rows per result set
perf.impact: Up to 100 sqlite queries per keystroke result
perf.safeFix: Load the pinned set once per booru into a Set and look up in memory

perf.issue: _getBooruHandler builds a fresh handler via the factory on every runSearch when an explicit booru is set
perf.safeFix: Cache the handler per booru, as _EditorSourceMixin does

perf.issue: searchAction calls Tools.forceClearMemoryCache(withLive: true) on every search and pull-to-refresh
perf.impact: Every decoded thumbnail of every tab is dropped; returning to other tabs redraws everything
perf.safeFix: Use trimMemoryCacheIfFull, as tab switches do (would change memory behaviour; needs a measure first)

perf.issue: Shimmer controller repeats from initState regardless of `enabled` (see bugs)
perf.impact: Continuous frame scheduling on the feed in low-performance mode
perf.safeFix: Honour enabled in ShimmerWrap and start repeat only when a child activates

perf.issue: Synchronous file read in initState (and synchronous write on drag end)
perf.impact: Blocking IO on the UI thread when the feed builds
perf.safeFix: Load async once into a store and keep it in memory

perf.impact: Rebuilds the banner every second during slow loads (small)
perf.safeFix: Only the elapsed-seconds Text listens to a ticker notifier
